title: fynkel.Oscillate
description: Moves the entity back and forth along `axis`: its position is the rest position plus `axis · amplitude · sin(2π · frequency · t + phase)`, where `t` starts at 0 when the component is added and the rest position is wherever the entity is when nothing else moves it — a transform write from gameplay shifts the rest position, it does not fight the oscillation. Pre-tick slot; a kinematic `RigidBody` on the entity rides along (a moving platform).

axis.description: Direction of travel, normalised at use; must not be zero.

amplitude.description: Metres either side of the rest position, `>= 0`.
